description: Create a new buy order on the TronSave market. Key inputs: `orderResourceType` (ENERGY|BANDWIDTH), `orderReceiver` (TRON base58), `orderUnitPrice` in SUN (NOT TRX), `orderDurationSec`, `orderResourceAmount`, and `paymentMethod`: (1) `onchain` — requires a signed payment tx in `paymentSignedTx`; (2) `internal` — deducts from internal balance. Side effect: creates a live order matchable by the market. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Always derive `orderUnitPrice` and `paymentPaymentAmount` from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for the same receiver, amount, and duration to avoid reverts.

orderDurationSec.description: Delegation duration in seconds. Must match the `durationSec` used in `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderReceiver.description: TRON base58 address (starts with T) that receives delegated resource. Same as `receiver` passed to `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderResourceAmount.description: Amount of ENERGY or BANDWIDTH units to purchase. Same as `buyResourceAmount` in estimate when applicable.

orderResourceType.description: Resource to buy: ENERGY (smart contracts) or BANDWIDTH (transactions). Must match `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`.

orderUnitPrice.description: Unit price in SUN. Prefer aligning with `minResourcePrice` or `buyResourcePrice` from the latest `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource` for the same receiver, amount, and duration.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method for this order: `onchain` (wallet signed tx) or `internal` (internal balance).

paymentPaymentAmount.description: Payment amount in SUN. Prefer deriving from `tronsave_estimate_buy_resource`; if converting to TRX, divide SUN by `1e6`.

paymentSignedTx.description: Required when `paymentMethod=onchain`. TronWeb-shaped signed TRON transaction (`{ txID, raw_data, raw_data_hex, signature[] }`). Must be produced client-side by the user's wallet; never fabricate or hand-edit.

raw_data.description: Raw transaction body produced by TronWeb (`raw_data`).

contract.description: At least one TRON contract entry; shape varies by contract type.

signature.description: Wallet signatures over `raw_data_hex`; usually a single hex string (130 chars for 65-byte secp256k1).

txID.description: Transaction hash (64 hex chars, lowercase, no `0x` prefix).

visible.description: Whether addresses inside `raw_data.contract` are base58 (`true`) vs hex (`false`).

name: tronsave_create_order

code.description: GraphQL mutation status code (HTTP-like; `0`/`200` indicates success). Always pair with `success` for routing.

orderId.description: Newly created order id (`MObjectId`); pass to `tronsave_get_order` to inspect status.

message.description: Human-readable status text. Populated even on success; localized error messages may appear here on failure.

success.description: Whether the mutation succeeded at the backend level. Always check this before reading `data`.

title: Create Order
